description: Expected span inventory for xrpld telemetry validation. Attribute keys follow the 2026-05-13 span-attr naming redesign (bare/underscore form; dotted xrpl.* reserved for resource attributes). Sourced from the *SpanNames.h headers. Spans marked "optional": true are conditional — they only fire under traffic the harness may not produce (e.g. gRPC client, missing-ledger fetch, mode transitions) and are not failed when absent.

spans.name: rpc.ws_message
spans.note: WebSocket RPC root span. The load generator uses WS, so this is the RPC entry span (not rpc.http_request, which needs an HTTP/JSON-RPC client).

spans.name: rpc.command.*
spans.note: Wildcard — matches rpc.command.server_info, rpc.command.ledger, etc.

spans.name: rpc.http_request
spans.note: HTTP/JSON-RPC root span. The harness load generator is WebSocket-only, so this does not fire.

spans.name: tx.receive
spans.note: Cross-node span: parent context propagated from the sender's tx.process via protobuf. Also carries tx_type and peer_version. tx_status is only set when a tx is suppressed/known-bad, so it is not a required attribute on every tx.receive.

spans.name: tx.apply
spans.note: Apply-step span inside BuildLedger. Carries tx_count/tx_failed (ledger_seq lives on the parent ledger.build span).

spans.name: tx.preflight
spans.note: Apply-pipeline stage span (stage=preflight). Shares a deterministic trace_id (txID[0:16]) with tx.preclaim/tx.transactor.

spans.name: tx.preclaim
spans.note: Apply-pipeline stage span (stage=preclaim).

spans.name: tx.transactor
spans.note: Apply-pipeline stage span (stage=apply). Also carries applied.

spans.name: txq.enqueue
spans.note: Only fires when a tx is queued (fee below open-ledger level). Requires fee escalation — driven by the txq-burst workload phase. tx_hash/tx_type/txq_status are set on every code path; fee_level_paid/required_fee_level are conditional (TxQ.cpp ~895-898, after the rejected and applied_direct early exits), so they are NOT guaranteed on every txq.enqueue span and cannot be required.

spans.name: txq.apply_direct
spans.note: Child of txq.enqueue when the tx applies directly without queueing.

spans.name: txq.accept
spans.note: Ledger-close accept loop. Fires on the consensus thread; only meaningful when the queue is non-empty.

spans.name: consensus.round
spans.note: Root consensus span created per round. Also carries trace_strategy, previous_ledger_seq, previous_proposers, previous_round_time_ms.

spans.name: consensus.proposal.send
spans.note: Also carries is_bow_out.

spans.name: consensus.ledger_close
spans.note: Also carries tx_count_open, close_time_resolution_ms.

spans.name: consensus.accept.apply
spans.note: Also carries close_time_correct, close_resolution_ms, consensus_state, proposing, round_time_ms, tx_count.

spans.name: consensus.validation.send
spans.note: follows-from consensus.accept. ledger_hash and full_validation are shared with peer.validation.receive (same keys, told apart by span name). Also carries validation_sign_time.

spans.name: consensus.proposal.receive
spans.note: Context-propagated from the sending peer. No required local attributes.

spans.name: consensus.validation.receive
spans.note: Context-propagated from the sending peer. No required local attributes.

spans.name: consensus.mode_change
spans.note: Only fires on an operating-mode transition; a steady cluster rarely changes mode after warmup.

spans.name: ledger.build
spans.note: tx_count/tx_failed live on the child tx.apply span, not here.

spans.name: ledger.acquire
spans.note: Only fires when a node must fetch a missing ledger (InboundLedger). A healthy local cluster rarely back-fills history.

spans.name: peer.validation.receive
spans.note: ledger_hash and full_validation are shared with consensus.validation.send (same keys, told apart by span name).

spans.name: pathfind.request
spans.note: Fires on ripple_path_find / path_find RPC. Driven by the ripple_path_find load in rpc_load_generator.py.

spans.name: pathfind.compute
spans.note: Only fires when PathRequest::doUpdate runs a computation; the self-to-self XRP probe from the load generator returns early without computing paths in a fresh cluster with no liquidity.

spans.name: pathfind.discover
spans.note: Graph exploration; only fires under pathfind.compute, which needs real path liquidity not present in the fresh test cluster.

spans.name: pathfind.update_all
spans.note: Async recomputation at ledger close; only fires when there are active path_find subscriptions (the one-shot ripple_path_find load does not register one).

spans.name: grpc.*
spans.note: Wildcard — grpc.<MethodName>. The harness has no gRPC client, so these do not fire. Tracked for completeness.

parent_child_relationships.skip_reason: rpc.ws_message and rpc.process run on different threads (the WS handler posts a coroutine to JobQueue for processing). Span context is not propagated across the thread boundary. Requires a C++ fix to capture and forward the span context through the coroutine lambda.

parent_child_relationships.description: Consensus round contains the accept sub-span
Pathfind request contains the compute sub-span
parent_child_relationships.skip_reason: pathfind.compute only fires when a path computation actually runs; the self-to-self XRP probe in a fresh cluster with no liquidity returns before computing, so the child is not emitted under the harness workload.
